```python
# Finite forward inference with explicit negation and rule preferences.
# Missing facts (including ages) are not assumed.
def lit(subject, relation, obj="", positive=True):
    return (subject, relation, obj, positive)

def opposite(a):
    return a[:3] + (not a[3],)

animals = [
    "bee", "badger", "frog", "snake", "seahorse", "vampire",
    "beaver", "ostrich", "dove", "woodpecker", "monkey", "swan",
    "rhino", "stork", "beetle", "goat", "ant", "dragon",
    "dinosaur", "flamingo", "finch", "pigeon", "fangtooth",
    "bison", "zebra", "dragonfly", "peafowl"
]

facts = {
    lit("bee", "card_color", "blue"),
    lit("bee", "tears_down", "badger", False),
    lit("frog", "card_color", "yellow"),
    lit("frog", "has_food", "spinach"),
    lit("snake", "reduced_hours"),
    lit("seahorse", "creates_castle", "vampire", False),
    # Source-domain definitions, not additional game actions or ages:
    lit("red", "primary_color"),
    lit("green", "primary_color"),
    lit("blue", "primary_color"),
    lit("spinach", "leafy_green"),
}

rules = []
def add(number, antecedents, conclusion):
    rules.append((number, frozenset(antecedents), conclusion))

for x in animals:
    add(1, [lit(x, "shouts", "beaver")],
        lit(x, "unites", "ostrich"))
    add(2, [lit(x, "tears_down", "dove")],
        lit("woodpecker", "takes_emperor", "monkey"))
    add(3, [lit(x, "persuades", "rhino")],
        lit("swan", "shouts", "beaver", False))
    add(5, [lit(x, "tears_down", "badger", False)],
        lit(x, "refuses_help", "badger"))
    add(6, [lit(x, "companionship", "ant")],
        lit("swan", "shouts", "peafowl", False))
    add(7, [lit(x, "unites", "ostrich")],
        lit("beetle", "trades", "stork"))
    add(8, [lit(x, "creates_castle", "dragon")],
        lit(x, "refuses_help", "dinosaur"))
    add(10, [lit(x, "wants_to_see", "goat")],
        lit("finch", "captures_king", "pigeon", False))
    add(12, [lit(x, "creates_castle", "vampire", False)],
        lit(x, "companionship", "ant"))
    add(13, [lit(x, "takes_emperor", "monkey")],
        lit("bee", "refuses_help", "dinosaur", False))
    add(14, [lit(x, "wants_to_see", "fangtooth")],
        lit(x, "shouts", "beetle", False))
    add(15, [lit(x, "trades", "bison")],
        lit("swan", "unites", "ostrich", False))
    add(17, [lit(x, "refuses_help", "dinosaur", False)],
        lit(x, "reveals_secret", "zebra"))
    add(18, [lit(x, "shouts", "beetle", False),
             lit(x, "reveals_secret", "zebra")],
        lit(x, "trades", "stork", False))
    add(19, [lit(x, "refuses_help", "badger")],
        lit(x, "shouts", "dragonfly"))
    add(20, [lit(x, "shouts", "dragonfly")],
        lit(x, "wants_to_see", "fangtooth"))
    add(22, [lit(x, "shouts", "peafowl")],
        lit(x, "shouts", "beaver"))

add(4, [lit("bee", "trades", "stork", False),
        lit("beetle", "trades", "stork")],
    lit("stork", "wants_to_see", "goat"))
add(9, [lit("flamingo", "smiles", "bee")],
    lit("bee", "shouts", "beetle"))
add(11, [lit("frog", "age_under_4")],
    lit("frog", "destroys_wall", "swan", False))
for color in ["red", "green", "blue", "yellow"]:
    add(16, [lit("frog", "card_color", color),
             lit(color, "primary_color")],
        lit("frog", "destroys_wall", "swan", False))
add(21, [lit("frog", "has_food", "spinach"),
         lit("spinach", "leafy_green")],
    lit("frog", "destroys_wall", "swan"))
add(23, [lit("snake", "reduced_hours")],
    lit("snake", "tears_down", "dove"))
add(24, [lit("frog", "destroys_wall", "swan")],
    lit("swan", "shouts", "peafowl"))

preferred = {(11, 21), (15, 1), (16, 21), (24, 6),
             (3, 22), (8, 13), (9, 14)}

# Each iteration rechecks ALL antecedents and removes conclusions of
# lower-priority rules when an applicable preferred rule contradicts them.
state = frozenset(facts)
seen = set()
settled = False
for iteration in range(1000):
    if state in seen:
        break
    seen.add(state)
    applicable = [r for r in rules if r[1] <= state]
    winners = [
        r for r in applicable
        if not any(
            (other[0], r[0]) in preferred
            and other[2] == opposite(r[2])
            for other in applicable
        )
    ]
    new_state = frozenset(facts | {r[2] for r in winners})
    if new_state == state:
        settled = True
        break
    state = new_state

if not settled:
    print("UNSUPPORTED: inference did not reach a fixed point")
    print("CHECK UNKNOWN")
else:
    query = lit("finch", "captures_king", "pigeon")
    positive = query in state
    negative = opposite(query) in state
    print("Finch captures pigeon king:", positive)
    print("Finch does not capture pigeon king:", negative)
    print("Applicable rule 10:",
          any(r[0] == 10 and r[1] <= state for r in rules))
    if positive and negative:
        print("UNSUPPORTED: conflicting query conclusions")
        print("CHECK UNKNOWN")
    else:
        expected = ("proved" if positive else
                    "disproved" if negative else "unknown")
        print("Expected answer:", expected)
        print("CHECK PASS" if expected == "disproved" else "CHECK FAIL")
```
